readme:
# e-fellows.net Scraper — DACH Elite Graduate Jobs

Tap into Germany's elite graduate talent pipeline — e-fellows.net lists exclusive trainee programs, consulting, and finance entry-level roles at top DACH employers like BCG, McKinsey, Deutsche Bank, Allianz, Bosch, BMW, Siemens and Bertelsmann.

Scrape premium graduate opportunities you will not find on generic job boards: structured trainee programs, Bachelor/Master thesis openings, PhD positions, working-student roles and permanent entry positions — all with the metadata that matters for talent intelligence (required degree, study field, start date, duration, languages, application deadline).

## Why e-fellows.net

e-fellows.net is THE platform for top DACH graduates. Employers pay premium to list here because they want the best: Bosch-Gruppe, Allianz, Deutsche Bank, Freshfields, KPMG, Bertelsmann, Hengeler Mueller, Gleiss Lutz, TNG Technology Consulting, McKinsey & Company, Deloitte, BMW Group, Munich Re, Vodafone and Universität St.Gallen are all active recruiters.

If you are tracking elite talent pipelines, benchmarking entry-level compensation at top firms, or enriching a graduate-focused career product, this is the dataset you need.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/e-fellows-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `e-fellows-scraper` to scrape job listings from e fellows. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Features

- **All job types** — Praktikum, Traineeprogramm, Werkstudent, Einstiegsposition, Führungsposition, Doktorand, Masterarbeit, Bachelorarbeit
- **Filter by industry / function** — IT, Consulting / Beratung, Finanzen / Bankwesen, Recht, Ingenieurwesen, Marketing / PR, Strategie / Business Development, HR, Wissenschaft / Forschung and more
- **Filter by city** — München, Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Köln, Düsseldorf, Stuttgart, Bonn and more
- **Required degree** — Bachelor, Master, PhD where published
- **Study field** — Informatik, BWL, Maschinenbau, Jura, etc.
- **Start date & duration** — critical for internship / trainee pipeline planning
- **Languages required** — Deutsch, English, French, etc.
- **Salary** — extracted where published in schema markup
- **Work mode** — Remote / Hybrid / Onsite
- **Full descriptions** — requirements, responsibilities, benefits
- **Employer profile URL + logo**
- **Direct apply link** to the employer's own career portal
- **Application deadline** and posted date

## Input

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["Consulting"],
  "location": "München",
  "jobType": "traineeprogramm",
  "category": "consulting-beratung",
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 100,
  "includeJobDetails": true,
  "proxyConfiguration": { "useApifyProxy": true }
}
```

### Input parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `searchQueries` | string[] | One or more keywords; runs as separate searches, results deduplicated |
| `searchQuery` | string | Single keyword (legacy, same as `searchQueries: [value]`) |
| `location` | string | German city (e.g. München, Berlin, Frankfurt) |
| `jobType` | enum | praktikum / traineeprogramm / werkstudent / einstieg / fuehrungsposition / doktorand / masterarbeit / bachelorarbeit |
| `category` | string | Industry or function alias (e.g. `it`, `consulting-beratung`, `finanzen-bankwesen-versicherungen`) |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | Max results per search keyword (default 100) |
| `maxResults` | integer | Total cap across all queries (0 = unlimited) |
| `includeJobDetails` | boolean | Fetch detail pages for full description + metadata (default true) |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | Apify proxy settings |

## Use cases

### Talent intelligence for consulting
Track McKinsey, BCG, Bain and Tier-2 consulting trainee pipelines across DACH. Who is hiring, in which cities, for which practice areas, starting when — all in one structured feed.

### Competitive hiring research for investment banks
Monitor Deutsche Bank, ING, KfW IPEX-Bank, Munich Re, DekaBank, Allianz and Big 4 entry-level programs. Benchmark headcount expansion against peer institutions.

### University career services
Curate high-quality opportunities for your top students. Filter by study field, required degree, and category to match offers with specific cohorts.

### HR tech & graduate career products
Enrich your graduate job board with exclusive e-fellows listings. Elite employer data is a retention driver for candidate audiences.

### Market research — DACH premium employer hiring trends
Track how Bosch-Gruppe, BMW Group, Siemens Advanta, Schneider Electric and Vodafone scale their trainee intake quarter over quarter.

### Candidate intelligence — PhD & thesis opportunities
Identify which firms publish PhD positions, master thesis opportunities and working-student roles — a strong signal for R&D investment and early-career strategy.

### Benchmarking — salary and benefits at elite DACH employers
Where salary data is published, compare consulting, banking, legal, and industrial trainee programs side-by-side.

## Pricing

Pay-per-result. Set `includeJobDetails: false` for listing-only mode (title, company, location, snippet) at lower cost, or keep the default `includeJobDetails: true` for full descriptions, requirements, languages, apply links and all metadata.

| Event | Price |
|---|---|
| Run start | $0.001 |
| Job listing result | $0.0015 |
| Full job detail | $0.003 |

**Listing-only mode** (`includeJobDetails: false`): 1,000 jobs ≈ **$1.50**

**Full detail mode** (`includeJobDetails: true`, default): 1,000 jobs ≈ **$3.00**
